name: Yamashina Natsue
source:
The proprietress of the “Yamashina-so” hot spring hotel.

She has big breasts with an estimated G-cup. She is a calm and gentle woman. However, when she is in the proprietress mode at work, she is a different person.

Her husband died in an accident five years ago.

The ryokan has no tourist resources other than its hot springs, and not many visitors come to the ryokan, but she continues to operate the ryokan in good spirits because it is the place her husband loved so much.

[From [url=http://www.r18game.com/tougenkyo/onsen/chara.html]official site[/url]]
